Deal facts.value: After Party A was sounded out in April 2013, Mac-Gray's board hired BofA Merrill Lynch and, on 06/24/2013, had its Special Committee approach 50 parties. Twenty signed NDAs, but only CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party C gave preliminary indications, alongside Party A's unsolicited $17–$19 proposal of 06/21. The Committee advanced those four to a staged-diligence round, in which strategic bidders saw less customer data, and then asked for final indications by 09/18. CSC/Pamplona bid $20.75 with fully committed Pamplona funding, Party B offered a $21.50 package including options, Party A stood at $18–$19, and Party C dropped out. The Committee chose CSC/Pamplona, obtained $21.25 in exchange for two weeks of exclusivity (later extended), and signed on 10/14/2013.
